parts.text: A student is investigating the transfer of thermal energy. He uses the apparatus shown in Fig. 1.1. Fig. 1.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The student pours 50 cm 3 of cold water into the glass tube and 300 cm 3 of hot water into the beaker. The water levels are approximately as shown in Fig. 1.1. In Table 1.1, record the temperatures θ C of the cold water and θ H of the hot water as shown on the thermometers in Fig. 1.1. parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The student lowers the glass tube into the beaker of hot water and immediately starts a stopclock. Table 1.1 shows the readings of the temperature θ C of the cold water and the temperature θ H of the hot water at times t = 30 s, 60 s, 90 s, 120 s, 150 s and 180 s. The student repeats the procedure with the same volume of hot water in the beaker but with 25 cm 3 of cold water in the glass tube. The results are shown in the table.
